ASA Ruling on Fernway Ltd

  • Upheld in part
  • Television, Video on demand
  • 03 July 2024

Ad description

A TV ad for a mushroom coffee showed a woman at work. A voice-over said “Focus all day”.

Issue

Two issues were investigated.

Assessment

1. Upheld

Focus claim was a specific health claim.

2. Not upheld

The general claim was accompanied.
